visual_brief: Tianjin CTF is a blue-silver glass tower with a broad base, softly tapering sides and a rounded, multi-lobed crown. Sweeping curved ribs distinguish its facade above the relatively low TEDA/Binhai district; nearby streets and landscaped plazas offer recognizable full-height views. Avoid confusing it with boxy Goldin Finance 117, stepped Guangzhou CTF or pointed Lotte World Tower.
notes: Seven distinct photographs retained; c1 and c2 recommended. All passed JPEG decoding, dimensions and visual inspection, with no visible watermarks. c1-c4 are larger SOM originals; c5-c7 have 1799-pixel long sides. Source pages credit Seth Powers but state no reuse licence. Repository follow-up check could not run because Python was unavailable. Writes stayed within the requested folders.
